t: Any advice on best place to buy a Martin guitar? : r/AcousticGuitar
s: July 6, 2024 - Martins vary a lot. I'd try to play one in person at a big shop (you may have to travel) or order online from somewhere with free returns. I'd consider buying a 000-18 Modern Deluxe so that you get wood binding and can avoid the dreaded "binding coming off" issue.
